response.original_title: Blek Le Rat - Original Stencil Pioneer
response.overview: This documentary explores the life and work of pioneering French street artist Blek Le Rat (Xavier Prou), widely regarded as the father of stencil graffiti. Accompanying the artist on a journey through France, the film examines his early experiments with stencil art, his creative techniques and influences, and his role in shaping modern street art. Featuring examples of his work spanning more than two decades, it offers an intimate look at the artist whose distinctive style helped pave the way for a new generation of street artists, including Banksy.
